glosses: próbować wzbudzić strach i poczucie zagrożenia
To make timid or afraid; to cause to feel fear or nervousness; to deter, especially by threats of violence.

examples.text: He's trying to intimidate you. If you ignore him, hopefully he'll stop.
His father tried to intimidate his son into staying, threatening him with banishment and a possible beating.

glosses: To fill (someone) with terror; to terrify.

examples.text: The gang continued to terrorize the neighborhood.
She felt terrorized by the constant threats.

glosses: To coerce (someone) by using threats or violence.
Inculcar o provocar miedo, temor o aprensión.
minacciare, anche con gesti o parole, per far tacere, inibire un comportamento, impedire un'azione

examples.text: con gravi scherzi tentò di intimidirla

glosses: mettere in stato di soggezione, disagio e/o paura, spesso tramite minaccia

examples.text: credeva di essere da loro amato ed invece li intimoriva continuamente
